title: Pair length-check machine
statement: For natural numbers $C$ and $e$, define a Boolean finite Turing machine by applying the pair-counting construction to the buffered composition of the machine that extracts pairs of bits of types $1$ and $0$ with the unary polynomial machine parameterized by $C$ and $e$.
caveat: The supplied definitions do not specify the pair-counting, pair-extraction, buffered-composition, or unary-polynomial constructions, so their behavior cannot be described more precisely.
